pages.text: Now you have a handful of Dust, what can you do with it?$(br2)For the unlucky guy with only Stones and Gravels, now you have an easier way to get Iron. $(br)For all the Dustologists, now you need to make an $(l:dust/integrated_block)Integrated Block$(/l). There is a chapter about how to use it. $(br) If you need a $(item)Lava Bucket$(), check out $(l:dust/lava)this entry$(/l).

Then you need to upgrade your $(l:dust/integrated_block)Integrated Block$(/l). Make four $(item)Integrated Frame Tier 1$().$(br2)Also make some $(l:ash/ash_collector)Ash Collector$(/l) to collect $(item)Ash$() from $(item)Furnace$().$(br2)Finally, you can make some $(item)Raw Ash Steel$(), and smelt them into $(item)Ash Steel Ingot$().

The next machine you need is $(l:dust/milling_machine)Milling & Assembly Machine$(/l).$(br)This machine allows you to upgrade your $(l:dust/integrated_block)Integrated Block$(/l) again, to make more advanced materials.
